description: Google Trends interest by region for one keyword: 0-100 interest per subregion of a country (or per country worldwide), past 7 days to 5 years, in one $0.03 GET. Use when you need where a keyword is searched most, for geo-targeting or local market research. A live call takes up to about 30 s. Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.03 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (us, gb, de, ...; uk = gb). Omit for worldwide.

keyword.description: One keyword or phrase (2-100 characters, no commas).
